what_to_detect: A Support N resolution (a PutCounter line with Support$) puts a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures.
near_miss: A Support resolution puts no counter (it was given no target).

what_to_detect: A Support N resolution on a permanent puts +1/+1 counters only on target creatures other than its source.
near_miss: A Support resolution on a permanent puts no counter because no other creature could be targeted.
